info.title: YouTubeTranscriptAPI REST API
info.summary: Fetch clean YouTube transcripts without 429 errors. Search, browse channels, and extract playlists through one REST API.
info.description:
Fetch YouTube transcripts, search YouTube, and list channel and playlist videos as JSON.

**Authentication.** Send an API key on every request: `Authorization: Bearer tk_live_…`. Create keys at https://youtubetranscriptapi.com/dashboard/keys.

**Credits.** Each operation's price is in its description and in `x-credit-cost`. Only successful (200) responses are charged; errors and rate-limited requests never are. Free operations still need a balance of at least 1 credit. Without enough credits you get 402 with a link to billing. Plans: https://youtubetranscriptapi.com/pricing.

**Errors.** Error bodies are `{ "detail": "…", "code": "…" }`. On 402 (`insufficient_credits`) `detail` is an object with the shortfall, a billing link and the plans; accounts without a plan also get `checkout_url`, a checkout that opens without signing in.

**Balance.** Successful responses carry X-Credits-Charged and X-Credits-Remaining. GET /account/whoami returns the plan and balance for free.

**Rate limits.** 300 requests per minute per API key by default, on a sliding one-minute window. Responses carry X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset; 429, 408 and 503 add Retry-After.

**Caching.** X-Cache-Status is HIT when a stored result was served and MISS otherwise. Stored responses cost the same as fresh ones.

get.description: Extract YouTube transcripts with or without timestamps. Returns JSON segments or one text string, optionally with video metadata. Stored transcripts return X-Cache-Status: HIT. Costs 1 credit per successful (200) response; errors are never charged.

parameters.name: video_url
parameters.description: An 11-character video ID, or a youtube.com, m.youtube.com, music.youtube.com or youtu.be URL (watch, shorts, embed and live links).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Preferred caption language code, such as en, es or de. Longer than 12 characters is truncated. If the video has no track in this language another one may be returned; the response's language field says which.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: json returns an array of segments; text returns the transcript as one string.

parameters.name: include_timestamp
parameters.description: Include start and duration (seconds) on each segment; with format=text, prefix each line with [start s]. 1, true, yes and on mean true; any other value means false.

parameters.name: send_metadata
parameters.description: Add a metadata block with the video title, author and thumbnail. 1, true, yes and on mean true; any other value means false.

bearerAuth.description: API key from the dashboard, sent as `Authorization: Bearer tk_live_…`.

Channel.name: channel
Channel.description: Channel as an @handle, a bare handle, a UC… channel ID, or a youtube.com channel URL (/channel/UC…, /@handle, /c/name or /user/name).

Continuation.name: continuation
Continuation.description: Reserved for paging. Not served yet: a request with this parameter gets 422 continuation_unavailable, is not charged and needs no balance.

XRateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed per minute for this API key.

XRateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current sliding one-minute window.

XRateLimitReset.description: Unix time, in seconds, when the current minute window ends.

XRequestId.description: Request ID for support. Echoes the X-Request-Id you sent, otherwise generated.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying: until the window ends on 429, 3 on 408 and 503.

XCreditsCharged.description: Credits this call cost. 0 for free operations. Sent on 200 responses only; errors are never charged.

XCreditsRemaining.description: Spendable credits left after this call. Sent on 200 responses; left out rather than estimated when the balance can't be read.

XCacheStatus.description: HIT when a stored result was served (transcripts, resolved channel IDs), otherwise MISS. Same price either way.

Unauthorized.description: The bearer token is missing (`missing_auth`) or invalid or revoked (`invalid_auth`).

value.detail: Missing bearer token
Invalid or revoked API key

Could not check your account right now; retry in a few seconds

code.description: Machine-readable code: validation_error, continuation_unavailable, missing_auth, invalid_auth, account_frozen, transcript_not_found, channel_not_found, playlist_not_found, upstream_timeout, rate_limited, upstream_error, config_missing or internal.

required.description: Credits the call needs: its cost, or 1 for a free operation.

message.description: The shortfall in numbers ("This call needs 20 credits; you have 5."), or that the credits have run out, then whether you need a plan, a top-up or an updated payment method.

action_label.description: Label for the suggested next step.

action_url.description: Billing page for the suggested next step.

alt_action_label.description: Monthly plans only: a second option, the upgrade to Annual.

checkout_url.description: Accounts without a plan only: a checkout for checkout_plan that opens without signing in, so it works from any browser, including the one inside an AI app. Valid for 7 days and only for this account. Absent for active or paused plans, which use action_url.

checkout_plan.description: The plan checkout_url buys. Present whenever checkout_url is.

plans.description: Current price and credits of each plan.

price_usd.description: Price per interval in US dollars.

credits_per_interval.description: Credits granted each interval: monthly each month, annual up front each year.

topup_usd_per_1k.description: Top-up price per 1,000 credits on this plan.

refund.description: Refund terms, where the plan has them.

url.description: Billing page with this plan selected.

plan_status.description: Subscription status (active, on_hold, past_due, cancelled, expired…); null without a subscription.

spendable.description: What the API can spend now: top-up credits, plus plan credits while the plan allows them.

plan.description: Plan credits, including any paused by a failed renewal.

topup.description: Free and top-up credits. They never expire.

TranscriptSegment.description: One caption line. start and duration are present when include_timestamp is true.

language.description: Language code of the returned caption track. Can differ from the requested language.

oneOf.description: format=text: one line per segment, each prefixed with [start s] when include_timestamp is true.

channelVerified.description: Whether the channel is verified; null when unknown.

lengthText.description: Duration as YouTube shows it, e.g. 3:33.

viewCountText.description: View count as YouTube shows it, e.g. 1.5B views.

publishedTimeText.description: Age as YouTube shows it, e.g. 14 years ago.

hasCaptions.description: true when the video has creator captions; null when unknown. Auto-generated captions may exist either way.

subscriberCount.description: Subscriber count as YouTube shows it, e.g. 26M subscribers.

verified.description: Whether the channel is verified; null when unknown.

lengthText.description: Duration as YouTube shows it, e.g. 15:22.

viewCountText.description: View count and age together, e.g. 3.2M views 2 weeks ago.

index.description: Zero-based position in the listing, as a string.

title.description: Playlist title; "Uploads from <channel>" for channel uploads.

numVideos.description: Video count as YouTube shows it, e.g. 47 videos. Null for channel uploads.

description.description: Playlist description. Absent for channel uploads.

continuation_token.description: Always null for now: only the first page is served.

has_more.description: Whether there are more videos than this page holds.

publishedAt.description: Publish time, ISO 8601. Can be approximate.

updatedAt.description: Last update time, ISO 8601, when known.
